1.3.0.en: Plenty of fixed, it has been a good year since this app got some love

1.4.3.en: Minor fixes for login and adding devices

1.4.6.en: Fixes to hostname, login and decos. changed default query time to 30s to relese pain on decos

1.4.7.en: Fix crash on startup when two devices get HTTP 403 due to Deco session limit; devices now re-authenticate automatically on next poll

1.4.8.en: Fix crash on client list, fix false WAN disconnected alarm, and stagger startup polling to resolve permanent 403 session-limit loop on multi-device setups

1.4.9.en: Fix permanent 403 session loop (shared single login across all nodes), remove stale CPU/RAM tiles from satellite nodes, map signal strength 1/2/3 to Weak/Good/Strong labels

1.4.10.en: Remove WAN disconnected alarm from satellite nodes (was showing "-"); map backhaul connection labels to readable WiFi 2.4 GHz / WiFi 5 GHz / Wired

1.4.14.en: Better handeling of login, improved client handeling when no devices on the accesspoint.

1.4.16.en: Small changes to the decryption of the keys in the login

1.4.18.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.19.en: Fixed 'wrong password' errors on newer HTTPS Deco firmware (e.g. X50-5G v2, P9). The app now auto-detects and remembers the correct login protocol per device. Also fixed noisy base64 log errors for plain-text device nicknames and redacted passwords from diagnostic logs.

1.4.20.en: Added three new flow cards: 'Any client changed status' (fires for any device without pre-selecting a specific client), 'A new client connected for the first time' (fires once per device ever seen), and 'A client changed Deco node' (fires when a specific client roams between Deco nodes, showing old and new node names).

1.4.21.en: Added two dashboard widgets: 'Client Presence' (shows online/offline status, Deco node, and last-seen time for any tracked device) and 'Network Throughput' (shows live download/upload speeds and connected client count across the mesh).

1.4.27.en: Fix LTE MB capabilities showing fractional values in insights

1.4.30.en: Improves logging when Failed to... while connecting
